visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with a short haircut, wearing a black t-shirt and a white plastic bag tied around his neck like a cape, stands in a lush green park. He gestures emphatically toward his chest and then displays a bottle of light-colored tea with a fierce, comedic expression. (2) Scene transitions to a younger man in a white t-shirt standing in a wooden pavilion. The 'superhero' man stands behind him, revealing a woman with long wavy hair who was previously hidden. The younger man looks bewildered while the background shows bright daylight and park greenery. (3) Close-up shots of the superhero man talking intensely into the camera, followed by him drinking the tea vigorously with sweat on his face. (4) The younger man is about to eat a hot dog in the pavilion when the superhero man suddenly appears and takes a large bite out of it, leaving the younger man in shock. (5) The superhero man is filmed running on a paved park path, wearing a black mini-skirt and fishnet stockings over his black shirt and plastic cape. He chases the camera (POV) while holding tea bottles and shouting. (6) A static product shot shows two bottles of 'Original Brand Barley Tea' positioned against a blurred green background. (7) The man drinks the tea again, looking up with a satisfied expression as animated heart icons float near his head.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged male with a crew cut, wearing a black t-shirt and a white plastic sheet cape. Later revealed to be wearing a black skirt and fishnet stockings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Outdoor park with tall green trees, walking paths, and a wooden pavilion structure.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bouncy comedic music begins. A high-arousal male voice speaks with exaggerated confidence. A quick 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene cut. (2) Vocal pitch shifts as a second male voice expresses confusion. A 'pop' SFX and 'ding' emphasize visual gags. BGM tempo remains constant and driving. (3) Sound of rhythmic liquid swallowing followed by a sharp 'click' of the bottle cap. Main vocal continues at a high speed with audible strain. (4) A loud 'crunch' SFX occurs as the superhero takes a bite of the hot dog, followed by an over-the-top chewing sound. The BGM beat drops for a comedic pause in speech. (5) Continuous heavy breathing and rhythmic footstep sounds are layered underneath the fast talking and loud BGM. The voice becomes shouting-level as it lists product benefits. (6) A high-pitched, frustrated female voice screams briefly over the music. A final celebratory 'ding' SFX marks the brand slogan reveal as the audio fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Absurd superhero intervention -> Persistent product chase -> Detailed product feature list -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To market 'Original Brand Barley Tea' using a high-energy, absurdist comedy format. The 'OK Superhero' character represents a humorous personification of the product's refreshing benefits, transforming a mundane tea advertisement into a viral-style comedic skit.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of the tea bottle, direct verbal description of its ingredients (no sugar, no caffeine, buckwheat), and a final slogan pointing to 7-11 stores.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses TikTok-style editing with fast cuts and high-density text to maintain attention. The cross-dressing element in the chase scene adds to the viral comedy appeal.
